title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:95638), Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k),Transfer Info:Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 ->FLAC -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC; amd Audience (shnid:113826), AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone;

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a scorching 1982 show featuring a smoking Mexicali Blues, Peggy‑O, Bird Song, Estimated, Stella and a uniquely rendered Sugaree.
ai_review.review: The matrix source is praised as crystal‑clear and the best version of this concert yet, delivering a vivid listening experience. The performance itself is described as one of the year's highlights with high energy throughout, standout moments on Mexicali Blues, Peggy‑O, Bird Song, Estimated, Stella and memorable openings with Iko Ikokie and Man Smart (Woman Smarter).

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and explicitly praise both the musical performance and the matrix recording quality, indicating an exceptional show with excellent sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very nice sounding matrix; described as clear, balanced and the best version of this show heard by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong set flow with memorable openings and a second‑set that keeps the energy high throughout.
